mapper.select: SELECT id, report_type, business_date, revision, status, model, prompt_version, input_hash, token_usage, content_json, content_md, data_as_of, is_synthetic, created_at, updated_at, collected_at, algorithm_version, data_scope, job_id FROM analysis_report WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT source_document_id,data_reference FROM report_source WHERE report_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_report( report_type, business_date, revision, status, model, prompt_version, input_hash, content_json, content_md, data_as_of, is_synthetic, collected_at, algorithm_version, data_scope, job_id) VALUES ( #{reportType}, #{businessDate}, #{revision}, 'SUCCESS', #{model}, #{promptVersion}, #{inputHash}, #{contentJson}, #{contentMd}, #{dataAsOf}, #{synthetic}, #{collectedAt}, #{algorithmVersion}, #{dataScope}, #{jobId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_report a WHERE is_synthetic=#{synthetic} AND report_type=#{reportType} AND business_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND (#{latestOnly}=FALSE OR NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_report newer WHERE newer.report_type=a.report_type AND newer.business_date=a.business_date AND newer.is_synthetic=a.is_synthetic AND newer.revision>a.revision ))

SELECT id, report_type, business_date, revision, status, model, prompt_version, input_hash, token_usage, content_json, content_md, data_as_of, is_synthetic, created_at, updated_at, collected_at, algorithm_version, data_scope, job_id FROM analysis_report WHERE report_type=#{type} AND business_date=#{date} AND is_synthetic=#{synthetic} ORDER BY revision DESC
SELECT input_json FROM report_input_snapshot WHERE report_id=#{id}
